issues.reason: Names and casing states the witness symbol is minted from the class "never sk_he_1 / sk_it_1", so sk_it_1 is the explicitly forbidden form; the class thing is correct and only the symbol is wrong.

The Degree level slot takes the surface adverb as a bare lemmatized symbol (very / really / slightly, and the fixed excessive / sufficient / insufficient); a double-quoted string is a string literal, a form reserved for Name / CardinalityPhrase / QuantifierPhrase surface records.

"LocatedIn is containment ONLY — in / at / inside / within"; a surface "of" therefore takes the entity-attached surface-preposition head on the (From sk_wool_1 calderwick) precedent, so LocatedIn here asserts a containment the preposition does not state.

No word in the text says Tampa is a city, so (Member tampa city) fails the Core-patterns "point at the words that put the atom there" test — the naming rule emits a kind atom only when a kind word sits inside or beside the name.
(Member florida state) is the same unlicensed world-knowledge kind — the text supplies no kind word for "Fla."

(Name okoro "Dr Okoro") licenses a symbol derived from the name rather than transcribed from the string, and (Name florida "Fla.") keeps the surface form in the string slot while giving the referent the stable symbol every other mention of Florida would reuse — a symbol is an identifier, so nothing here is false, ill-typed or over-asserted.

The instruction set provides no carrier for a spatial particle stacked on a degree-modified adjective (the verb_particle rule is verb-only) and its standing direction for an unslottable modifier is to leave it out rather than mis-slot it, so dropping "out" makes no atom false — a coverage gap mistaken for a defect.

gaps_confirmed: degree-result "so ADJ that <clause>" — the instruction set covers "too ADJ to V" and "ADJ enough to V" but gives no encoding for a so-degree with a finite result clause and no head for the correlative
the "City, State" comma appositive ("Tampa, Fla.") — nested place names in apposition have no stated containment route
"any" as a negative-polarity plural determiner under a denial ("share ... with any governments") — neither the existential nor the quantifier sections address it
new_gaps: "far out" — a spatial particle modifying a degree-modified adjective has no licensed carrier, so the "out" is simply unrecorded
an abbreviated place name ("Fla.") — the naming rule fixes the Name string as the surface form but says nothing about whether the symbol may expand the abbreviation for coreference stability
